Module Name (EN): AI and Data Literacy for Professionals
Description (EN): A shared on-ramp that builds a common language across AI, machine learning, generative AI, and the data value chain. Participants learn how modern AI systems create value, where they fail, and how data-driven decisions are made in organisations. The module anchors all subsequent pathways and requires no technical background.
الوصف (AR): بوابة مشتركة تبني لغة موحدة حول الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة والذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي وسلسلة قيمة البيانات. يتعرف المشاركون على كيفية تحقيق أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي للقيمة ومواطن إخفاقها وكيفية اتخاذ القرارات المبنية على البيانات، دون الحاجة لخلفية تقنية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Business professionals, decision-makers, fresh graduates, non-technical staff
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Explain core AI, ML, and generative-AI concepts and their business applications in plain language
• Differentiate between rule-based systems, machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI
• Analyze the data value chain from collection to decision within an organisational context
• Evaluate AI use cases for feasibility, value, and risk using a structured framework
• Identify common failure modes, biases, and limitations of AI systems
• Interpret basic data visualisations and model outputs to support decisions
Topics المواضيع:
1. The AI, ML, and generative-AI landscape and terminology
2. How machine learning works: data, models, predictions
3. The data value chain and data-driven decision-making
4. Generative AI and large language models in the workplace
5. AI opportunity and risk assessment frameworks
6. National AI strategy context (NSDAI) and workforce roles
7. Hands-on: exploring AI tools and reading model outputs
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: No-code AI tools, BI dashboards, AI assistants
Stackability التكديس: Entry badge; counts toward all certificates and both role tracks.

Module Name (EN): Generative AI and Prompt Engineering Essentials
اسم الوحدة (AR): أساسيات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي وهندسة الأوامر
Description (EN): A practical module on working productively and safely with generative-AI tools. Participants master prompt design patterns, output evaluation, and workflow integration for text, code, and data tasks. It equips every professional to use LLM-based assistants responsibly and effectively.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تطبيقية للعمل بإنتاجية وأمان مع أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي. يتقن المشاركون أنماط تصميم الأوامر وتقييم المخرجات ودمجها في مهام النصوص والبرمجة والبيانات، بما يمكّن كل مهني من استخدام المساعدات الذكية بمسؤولية وفاعلية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: All professionals, analysts, technical and non-technical staff
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Explain how large language models generate output and why they hallucinate
• Design effective prompts using role, context, format, and few-shot patterns
• Apply iterative prompt refinement to improve output quality and reliability
• Evaluate generative-AI outputs for accuracy, bias, and appropriateness
• Integrate generative-AI assistants into document, analysis, and coding workflows
• Assess data-privacy and confidentiality risks when using AI tools
Topics المواضيع:
1. How LLMs work: tokens, context, and limitations
2. Prompt design patterns and structured prompting
3. Iterative refinement and prompt evaluation
4. GenAI for documents, analysis, and code
5. Hallucination, bias, and output verification
6. Safe and compliant use of AI tools at work
7. Hands-on prompt engineering lab
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: ChatGPT/Claude-class assistants, AI coding assistants, evaluation checklists
Stackability التكديس: Foundation badge; recommended before all GenAI engineering modules.

Module Name (EN): Python Programming for Data and AI
Description (EN): An intensive hands-on module that builds job-ready Python skills for data and AI work. Participants progress from core language constructs to scientific computing with NumPy and pandas, version control, and clean, testable code. It is the technical gateway to both the AI Engineer and Data Scientist tracks.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تطبيقية مكثفة تبني مهارات بايثون الجاهزة لسوق العمل في مجالي البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي. يتدرج المشاركون من أساسيات اللغة إلى الحوسبة العلمية باستخدام NumPy وPandas والتحكم بالإصدارات وكتابة كود نظيف قابل للاختبار، وهي البوابة التقنية لمساري مهندس الذكاء الاصطناعي وعالم البيانات.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Aspiring AI engineers and data scientists, developers, technical graduates
Prerequisites المتطلبات السابقة: Basic computer literacy; programming logic recommended
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Develop structured Python programs using functions, data structures, and object-oriented design
• Implement data manipulation and numerical computation workflows with pandas and NumPy
• Apply version control with Git and collaborative repository workflows
• Debug, test, and refactor Python code using systematic practices
• Build reusable scripts and notebooks for data acquisition and processing
• Organise projects with virtual environments and dependency management
Topics المواضيع:
1. Python core: types, control flow, functions, OOP
2. Data structures and file/API data handling
3. NumPy arrays and vectorised computation
4. pandas for tabular data manipulation
5. Git, GitHub, and collaboration workflows
6. Testing, debugging, and code quality
7. Environments and dependency management
8. Mini-project: end-to-end data processing pipeline
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Python, NumPy, pandas, Git/GitHub, VS Code, pytest, Jupyter
Stackability التكديس: Core technical badge; prerequisite for all track-level technical modules.

Module Name (EN): Data Wrangling, SQL and Exploratory Analysis
Description (EN): A practical module covering the full journey from raw data to analysis-ready insight. Participants query relational databases with SQL, clean and reshape messy datasets, engineer features, and conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis. The module instils the data-quality discipline every AI and analytics role depends on.
الوصف (AR): وحدة عملية تغطي الرحلة الكاملة من البيانات الخام إلى الرؤى الجاهزة للتحليل. يستعلم المشاركون من قواعد البيانات العلائقية باستخدام SQL، وينظفون البيانات ويعيدون تشكيلها، ويبنون الخصائص، وينفذون تحليلًا استكشافيًا دقيقًا يرسّخ انضباط جودة البيانات الذي تعتمد عليه كل أدوار الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Analysts, engineers, and scientists preparing for track-level modules
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design and execute SQL queries including joins, aggregations, and window functions
• Diagnose data-quality issues and implement systematic cleaning strategies
• Transform and reshape datasets for analysis using pandas
• Engineer meaningful features from raw structured data
• Conduct exploratory data analysis to surface patterns, anomalies, and relationships
• Communicate EDA findings through clear visual and written summaries
Topics المواضيع:
1. Relational databases and SQL fundamentals
2. Advanced SQL: joins, aggregation, window functions
3. Data-quality assessment and cleaning workflows
4. Reshaping, merging, and transforming datasets
5. Feature engineering for analytics and ML
6. Exploratory data analysis and visual profiling
7. EDA case study on a real government-style dataset
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: SQL (PostgreSQL), pandas, Jupyter, Matplotlib/Seaborn
Assessment التقييم: SQL labs; EDA project with report
Stackability التكديس: Foundation badge; required for Data Scientist track, recommended for AI Engineer track.

Description (EN): A governance-focused module aligning practice with Saudi national frameworks including PDPL, NDMO data standards, and SDAIA AI-ethics principles. Participants learn to assess fairness, transparency, privacy, and accountability across the AI lifecycle. The module prepares professionals to build and operate AI systems that are compliant and trustworthy by design.
الوصف (AR): وحدة متخصصة في الحوكمة تواءم الممارسة مع الأطر الوطنية السعودية بما فيها نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية ومعايير مكتب إدارة البيانات الوطنية ومبادئ أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي الصادرة عن سدايا. يتعلم المشاركون تقييم العدالة والشفافية والخصوصية والمساءلة عبر دورة حياة الذكاء الاصطناعي لبناء أنظمة موثوقة ومتوافقة تصميمًا.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: All AI and data practitioners, compliance and governance staff
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Explain Saudi data-protection requirements (PDPL) and NDMO governance standards
• Apply SDAIA AI-ethics principles across the AI system lifecycle
• Analyze AI systems for bias, fairness, and disparate impact
• Evaluate privacy risks and apply data-minimisation and anonymisation techniques
• Design documentation, model cards, and audit trails for accountable AI
• Assess third-party AI services for compliance and risk
Topics المواضيع:
1. The responsible-AI landscape and SDAIA ethics principles
2. PDPL and NDMO data-governance frameworks
3. Bias, fairness, and impact assessment
4. Privacy-preserving data handling
5. Transparency, explainability, and documentation
6. AI risk management and compliance workflows
7. Case studies: governance in government AI deployments
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Model cards, bias-audit toolkits, PDPL/NDMO checklists
Stackability التكديس: Foundation badge; required for Expert-level certificates in both tracks.

Description (EN): A hands-on foundation in supervised and unsupervised learning that teaches the complete modelling workflow. Participants frame business problems as ML tasks, train and tune models with scikit-learn, and evaluate them with the right metrics. The module ends with an end-to-end modelling project on real data.
الوصف (AR): أساس تطبيقي في التعلم الخاضع وغير الخاضع للإشراف يغطي سير عمل النمذجة الكامل. يصوغ المشاركون المشكلات كمهام تعلم آلة ويدربون النماذج ويضبطونها باستخدام scikit-learn ويقيّمونها بالمقاييس المناسبة، وتختتم الوحدة بمشروع نمذجة متكامل على بيانات حقيقية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Developers, engineers, analysts entering AI engineering; cross-listed to Data Scientist track
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Frame business problems as supervised or unsupervised learning tasks
• Implement the end-to-end ML workflow from data splitting to model selection
• Develop classification and regression models using scikit-learn pipelines
• Apply feature engineering, scaling, and encoding techniques appropriately
• Evaluate models using suitable metrics, cross-validation, and error analysis
• Diagnose and mitigate overfitting, underfitting, and data leakage
• Optimize model performance through systematic hyperparameter tuning
Topics المواضيع:
1. ML problem framing and workflow design
2. Supervised learning: regression and classification
3. Feature engineering and preprocessing pipelines
4. Model evaluation, metrics, and cross-validation
5. Tree ensembles: random forests and gradient boosting
6. Unsupervised learning: clustering and dimensionality reduction
7. Hyperparameter tuning and model selection
8. End-to-end modelling project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: scikit-learn, pandas, Jupyter, XGBoost, Matplotlib
Stackability التكديس: Core ML badge; required for all Specialist AI Engineer modules and DSC-211.

Description (EN): A practical introduction to neural networks that takes engineers from backpropagation mechanics to training real models on GPUs. Participants build, train, and debug networks in PyTorch, apply transfer learning, and manage experiments professionally. It is the gateway to NLP, computer vision, and generative-AI specialisations.
الوصف (AR): مدخل عملي للشبكات العصبية ينقل المهندسين من آليات الانتشار الخلفي إلى تدريب نماذج حقيقية على وحدات معالجة الرسومات. يبني المشاركون الشبكات ويدربونها ويصححونها في PyTorch مع تطبيق التعلم بالنقل وإدارة التجارب باحترافية، وهي بوابة تخصصات معالجة اللغة والرؤية الحاسوبية والذكاء التوليدي.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Engineers who completed Applied ML; developers moving into deep learning
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Explain neural-network architectures, activation functions, and backpropagation
• Implement feed-forward, convolutional, and recurrent networks in PyTorch
• Develop robust training loops with proper loss functions and optimisers
• Apply regularisation, normalisation, and learning-rate scheduling to stabilise training
• Implement transfer learning with pretrained models for new tasks
• Track, compare, and reproduce experiments using experiment-management tools
Topics المواضيع:
1. Neural networks, activations, and backpropagation
2. PyTorch tensors, autograd, and training loops
3. CNNs for images; RNNs and sequence basics
4. Regularisation, normalisation, and optimisation
5. Transfer learning and pretrained models
6. GPU training and experiment tracking
7. Lab: build and tune an image classifier
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: PyTorch, torchvision, Weights & Biases, CUDA, Hugging Face Hub
Stackability التكديس: Deep-learning badge; gateway to all Specialist AI Engineer modules.

Module Name (EN): Software Engineering Practices for AI Systems
اسم الوحدة (AR): ممارسات هندسة البرمجيات لأنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي
Description (EN): A production-engineering module that turns model builders into software engineers. Participants design clean APIs around models, containerise services with Docker, automate testing and CI/CD, and structure AI codebases for maintainability. These practices underpin every deployment module later in the track.
الوصف (AR): وحدة هندسة إنتاجية تحوّل بناة النماذج إلى مهندسي برمجيات. يصمم المشاركون واجهات برمجية نظيفة حول النماذج ويحوّلون الخدمات إلى حاويات باستخدام Docker ويؤتمتون الاختبارات وخطوط CI/CD وينظمون قواعد الكود لقابلية الصيانة، وهي ممارسات تؤسس لكل وحدات النشر اللاحقة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: AI practitioners preparing for production engineering roles
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design RESTful APIs that expose ML models as reliable services
• Implement containerised AI services using Docker and compose workflows
• Develop automated unit, integration, and model-behaviour tests
• Build CI/CD pipelines that validate and ship AI code changes
• Apply clean-architecture and configuration-management patterns to AI codebases
• Evaluate code quality using reviews, linting, and static analysis
Topics المواضيع:
1. Structuring AI projects and clean architecture
2. APIs for model serving with FastAPI
3. Docker and containerised services
4. Testing strategies for ML code
5. CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions
6. Configuration, secrets, and logging practices
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: FastAPI, Docker, pytest, GitHub Actions, pydantic
Stackability التكديس: Engineering badge; required for MLOps and production modules.

Description (EN): A specialist module on modern NLP built around the transformer architecture. Participants tokenise and model text, fine-tune pretrained transformers for classification and extraction tasks, and handle Arabic-language processing challenges. The module bridges classic NLP pipelines and today's LLM-centric stack.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية في معالجة اللغة الطبيعية الحديثة مبنية حول معمارية المحولات. يتعامل المشاركون مع الترميز ونمذجة النصوص وضبط المحولات المدربة مسبقًا لمهام التصنيف والاستخراج مع معالجة تحديات اللغة العربية، وتجسر الوحدة بين خطوط المعالجة الكلاسيكية ومنظومة النماذج اللغوية الحديثة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: AI engineers specialising in language applications
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Implement text-preprocessing and tokenisation pipelines including Arabic-specific handling
• Explain attention mechanisms and the transformer architecture
• Fine-tune pretrained transformer models for classification, NER, and QA tasks
• Develop embedding-based semantic search and similarity applications
• Evaluate NLP models with task-appropriate metrics and error analysis
• Optimize inference speed and memory for transformer deployment
Topics المواضيع:
1. Text processing, tokenisation, and embeddings
2. Attention and the transformer architecture
3. Fine-tuning BERT-family models for downstream tasks
4. Arabic NLP: challenges, models, and resources
5. Semantic search with sentence embeddings
6. Evaluation and error analysis for NLP
7. Inference optimisation and serving
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, sentence-transformers, CAMeL Tools
Stackability التكديس: NLP specialisation badge; feeds the GenAI Engineering specialisation.

Description (EN): A specialist module for building production computer-vision capabilities. Participants develop image classification, object detection, and segmentation solutions using modern architectures and transfer learning. The module emphasises dataset curation, augmentation, and deployment of vision models to real applications.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية لبناء قدرات الرؤية الحاسوبية الإنتاجية. يطور المشاركون حلول تصنيف الصور واكتشاف الكائنات والتجزئة باستخدام المعماريات الحديثة والتعلم بالنقل، مع تركيز على تنسيق مجموعات البيانات والتعزيز ونشر نماذج الرؤية في تطبيقات حقيقية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: AI engineers specialising in vision applications
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Implement image classification pipelines using CNNs and vision transformers
• Develop object-detection and segmentation solutions with modern frameworks
• Design dataset curation, labelling, and augmentation strategies
• Apply transfer learning and fine-tuning to domain-specific vision tasks
• Evaluate vision models using appropriate metrics such as mAP and IoU
• Deploy optimised vision models to cloud and edge targets
Topics المواضيع:
1. Image data, preprocessing, and augmentation
2. CNN architectures and vision transformers
3. Object detection with YOLO-family models
4. Semantic and instance segmentation
5. Dataset curation and annotation workflows
6. Model evaluation for vision tasks
7. Deployment and edge optimisation
8. Vision application project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: PyTorch, torchvision, YOLO/Ultralytics, OpenCV, ONNX
Stackability التكديس: Vision specialisation badge; elective within AI Engineer Specialist certificate.

Description (EN): A hands-on module for engineering applications on top of LLM APIs and open-weight models. Participants design prompt pipelines, structured outputs, function calling, and evaluation harnesses, and architect complete LLM-powered products. It establishes the engineering discipline behind reliable generative-AI software.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تطبيقية لهندسة التطبيقات فوق واجهات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة والنماذج مفتوحة الأوزان. يصمم المشاركون خطوط الأوامر والمخرجات المهيكلة واستدعاء الوظائف ومنصات التقييم ويبنون منتجات متكاملة مدعومة بالنماذج اللغوية، بما يرسّخ الانضباط الهندسي وراء برمجيات الذكاء التوليدي الموثوقة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Engineers building generative-AI products and services
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design application architectures around LLM APIs and open-weight models
• Implement structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration
• Develop robust prompt pipelines with templating and guardrails
• Build evaluation harnesses to measure quality, safety, and regression
• Optimize latency and token cost across model and caching choices
• Compare commercial and open-weight models for a given use case
Topics المواضيع:
1. LLM application architecture patterns
2. Working with LLM APIs and open-weight models
3. Structured outputs and function calling
4. Prompt pipelines, templating, and guardrails
5. LLM evaluation: golden sets, LLM-as-judge, metrics
6. Cost, latency, and caching strategies
7. Building a complete LLM-powered application
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, pydantic, promptfoo/evals, vLLM
Assessment التقييم: Labs; LLM application project with evaluation report
Stackability التكديس: GenAI engineering badge; core of the GenAI Engineering specialisation.

Description (EN): A deep, practical module on grounding LLMs in enterprise knowledge. Participants build the full RAG pipeline — ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector retrieval, reranking, and generation — and evaluate answer faithfulness systematically. The module covers advanced patterns including hybrid search and multi-document reasoning for production-grade assistants.
الوصف (AR): وحدة عملية متعمقة في تأصيل النماذج اللغوية بمعرفة المؤسسة. يبني المشاركون خط RAG الكامل من الاستيعاب والتقطيع والتضمين والاسترجاع المتجهي وإعادة الترتيب إلى التوليد، مع تقييم منهجي لأمانة الإجابات، وتغطي الوحدة أنماطًا متقدمة تشمل البحث الهجين والاستدلال متعدد المستندات للمساعدات الإنتاجية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: GenAI engineers building knowledge assistants and enterprise search
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design end-to-end RAG architectures for enterprise knowledge bases
• Implement ingestion, chunking, and embedding pipelines for heterogeneous documents
• Develop retrieval stacks combining vector, keyword, and hybrid search with reranking
• Evaluate RAG quality using faithfulness, relevance, and answer-correctness metrics
• Optimize retrieval parameters, context construction, and citation grounding
• Validate systems against hallucination and stale-knowledge failure modes
Topics المواضيع:
1. RAG architecture and when to use it versus fine-tuning
2. Document ingestion, parsing, and chunking strategies
3. Embeddings and vector databases
4. Hybrid retrieval and reranking
5. Context construction and citation grounding
6. RAG evaluation frameworks
7. Advanced patterns: multi-hop, agentic RAG
8. Production RAG project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Vector DBs (Qdrant/pgvector), LangChain/LlamaIndex, RAGAS, rerankers
Assessment التقييم: Labs; enterprise RAG project with evaluation
Stackability التكديس: RAG badge; prerequisite for Agentic AI Systems Engineering.

Description (EN): A specialist module on customising foundation models efficiently. Participants prepare instruction datasets, apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), align models with preference optimisation, and quantise them for deployment. The module gives engineers a decision framework for when to prompt, retrieve, or fine-tune.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية في تخصيص النماذج الأساسية بكفاءة. يجهّز المشاركون بيانات التعليمات ويطبقون الضبط الدقيق الموفر للمعاملات (LoRA/QLoRA) ومواءمة النماذج بتحسين التفضيلات وتكميمها للنشر، وتمنح الوحدة المهندسين إطار قرار للاختيار بين الأوامر أو الاسترجاع أو الضبط الدقيق.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: GenAI engineers customising models for domain tasks
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Compare prompting, RAG, and fine-tuning strategies for a given requirement
• Design high-quality instruction and preference datasets
• Implement parameter-efficient fine-tuning using LoRA and QLoRA
• Apply quantisation techniques to reduce model footprint
• Evaluate fine-tuned models against baselines with rigorous benchmarks
• Validate adapted models for regression, safety, and domain fitness
Topics المواضيع:
1. Adaptation strategy: prompt vs RAG vs fine-tune
2. Instruction dataset design and curation
3. PEFT methods: LoRA, QLoRA, adapters
4. Preference alignment (DPO) overview
5. Quantisation and efficient inference
6. Evaluation and regression testing of tuned models
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Hugging Face PEFT/TRL, bitsandbytes, Axolotl, lm-eval-harness
Stackability التكديس: Model-adaptation badge; elective within GenAI Engineering specialisation.

اسم الوحدة (AR): عمليات تعلم الآلة: نشر النماذج والأتمتة
Description (EN): A comprehensive module on operationalising machine learning. Participants build reproducible training pipelines, register and version models and data, deploy scalable serving endpoints, and automate retraining with monitoring for drift. The module establishes the MLOps backbone that Expert-level reliability and LLMOps modules extend.
الوصف (AR): وحدة شاملة في تشغيل تعلم الآلة. يبني المشاركون خطوط تدريب قابلة للتكرار ويسجلون النماذج والبيانات بإصدارات ويطلقون نقاط خدمة قابلة للتوسع ويؤتمتون إعادة التدريب مع مراقبة الانحراف، بما يؤسس العمود الفقري لعمليات تعلم الآلة الذي تبني عليه وحدات الموثوقية وLLMOps للخبراء.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: AI engineers responsible for production ML systems
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design end-to-end MLOps architectures spanning training, serving, and monitoring
• Implement reproducible pipelines with data and model versioning
• Deploy models as scalable, containerised inference services
• Develop automated retraining and CI/CD/CT workflows
• Implement monitoring for data drift, concept drift, and performance decay
• Evaluate deployment strategies including canary, blue-green, and shadow releases
Topics المواضيع:
1. MLOps maturity model and system architecture
2. Experiment tracking and model registry
3. Data versioning and feature stores
4. Pipeline orchestration and automation
5. Model serving: batch, online, streaming
6. Drift detection and monitoring
7. Release strategies and rollback
8. MLOps platform project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: MLflow, DVC, Airflow/Prefect, Docker, Kubernetes basics, Evidently
Stackability التكديس: MLOps badge; prerequisite for LLMOps and reliability modules.

Description (EN): An expert module on designing, building, securing, and operating enterprise agentic systems that plan, reason, use tools, and manage memory across multi-step workflows. Participants implement ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Reflection patterns, orchestrate multi-agent architectures, integrate tools via the Model Context Protocol, and harden agents with guardrails and red-team testing. The module culminates in deploying a production-grade agentic system in a simulated enterprise environment.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء في تصميم وبناء وتأمين وتشغيل أنظمة وكيلية مؤسسية قادرة على التخطيط والاستدلال واستخدام الأدوات وإدارة الذاكرة عبر سير عمل متعدد الخطوات. يطبق المشاركون أنماط ReAct وPlan-and-Execute وReflection وينسقون معماريات متعددة الوكلاء ويدمجون الأدوات عبر بروتوكول MCP ويحصّنون الوكلاء بالحواجز الوقائية واختبارات الفريق الأحمر، وتُختتم الوحدة بنشر نظام وكيلي بمستوى إنتاجي في بيئة مؤسسية محاكاة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Senior AI engineers, AI architects, technical leads
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design agentic architectures with planning, reasoning, tool use, and memory
• Implement ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Reflection patterns in working agents
• Develop multi-agent systems with orchestration, delegation, and task routing
• Integrate tools and enterprise APIs using the Model Context Protocol
• Design state management and short/long-term memory with vector stores
• Implement automated guardrails and red-team agents against attacks
• Optimize agent performance, cost, and reliability with tracing and monitoring
• Validate a deployed agentic system in a simulated enterprise environment
Topics المواضيع:
1. Agentic system architectures and components
2. Planning and reasoning patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflection
3. Tool use, function calling, and MCP integration
4. Memory and state management with vector databases
5. Single-agent versus multi-agent architectures
6. Hierarchical delegation and agent orchestration
7. Flow engineering over prompt engineering
8. Guardrails, security, and adversarial testing
9. Observability, cost optimisation, and monitoring
10. Capstone: enterprise agentic system deployment
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: LangGraph, MCP, vector DBs, agent-tracing platforms (LangSmith), guardrails frameworks
Assessment التقييم: Labs; security report; deployed agent capstone
Stackability التكديس: Flagship Expert badge; anchors the GenAI Engineering specialisation. Derived from the existing Advanced Agentic AI Systems programme.

اسم الوحدة (AR): عمليات النماذج اللغوية ومراقبة الذكاء الاصطناعي الإنتاجي
Description (EN): An expert module on operating LLM and generative-AI workloads in production. Participants implement tracing, quality monitoring, feedback loops, and incident response for AI services, extending MLOps discipline to non-deterministic systems. The module covers evaluation-in-production, prompt/version management, and reliability engineering for AI platforms.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء في تشغيل أحمال النماذج اللغوية والذكاء التوليدي في الإنتاج. يطبق المشاركون التتبع ومراقبة الجودة وحلقات التغذية الراجعة والاستجابة للحوادث لخدمات الذكاء الاصطناعي، بما يمد انضباط MLOps إلى الأنظمة غير الحتمية، وتغطي الوحدة التقييم في الإنتاج وإدارة إصدارات الأوامر وهندسة الموثوقية لمنصات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Engineers operating GenAI services at scale
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design observability architectures for LLM applications with distributed tracing
• Implement online evaluation, quality scoring, and user-feedback loops
• Develop prompt and model version-management workflows with safe rollouts
• Analyze production incidents in AI systems and build response runbooks
• Implement SLOs, alerting, and reliability dashboards for AI services
• Optimize the operations lifecycle for continuous improvement of deployed LLM systems
Topics المواضيع:
1. From MLOps to LLMOps: what changes
2. Tracing and logging for LLM pipelines
3. Online evaluation and quality monitoring
4. Prompt registries and version management
5. Feedback loops and data flywheels
6. SLOs, alerting, and incident response
7. Reliability engineering for AI platforms
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: LangSmith/Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, evaluation pipelines
Stackability التكديس: Expert operations badge; part of the MLOps & Reliability specialisation.

Module Name (EN): AI Security, Guardrails and Red Teaming
اسم الوحدة (AR): أمن الذكاء الاصطناعي والحواجز الوقائية والفريق الأحمر
Description (EN): An expert module on securing AI systems against adversarial threats. Participants analyse attack surfaces including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, and model extraction, then design layered defences with guardrails, filtering, and access controls. Structured red-team exercises teach systematic security validation of LLM and agentic applications.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء في تأمين أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي ضد التهديدات العدائية. يحلل المشاركون أسطح الهجوم بما فيها حقن الأوامر وكسر القيود وتسميم البيانات واستخراج النماذج، ثم يصممون دفاعات متعددة الطبقات بالحواجز الوقائية والتصفية وضوابط الوصول، مع تمارين فريق أحمر منظمة للتحقق الأمني المنهجي من تطبيقات النماذج اللغوية والوكيلية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Senior engineers, security specialists, AI platform owners
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Analyze AI attack surfaces using OWASP LLM Top-10 and threat modelling
• Evaluate systems against prompt injection, jailbreak, and data-exfiltration attacks
• Design layered guardrail architectures for inputs, outputs, and tools
• Implement content filtering, PII protection, and policy enforcement
• Conduct structured red-team exercises against LLM and agentic applications
• Develop security test suites and reporting aligned with governance requirements
Topics المواضيع:
1. AI threat landscape and OWASP LLM Top-10
2. Prompt injection and jailbreak techniques
3. Data poisoning and supply-chain risks
4. Guardrail architecture and policy enforcement
5. Red-teaming methodology and tooling
6. Security evaluation and reporting
7. Compliance alignment with national frameworks
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Garak/PyRIT, guardrails frameworks, NeMo Guardrails, threat-modelling templates
Stackability التكديس: Security badge; required for AI Engineer Expert certificate.

Module Name (EN): AI Performance, Scalability and Cost Optimization
اسم الوحدة (AR): أداء الذكاء الاصطناعي وقابلية التوسع وتحسين التكلفة
Description (EN): An expert module on engineering AI systems that are fast, scalable, and economical. Participants profile inference workloads, apply batching, caching, quantisation, and routing strategies, and design autoscaling serving infrastructure. The module builds the FinOps discipline to run national-scale AI services within budget.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء في هندسة أنظمة ذكاء اصطناعي سريعة وقابلة للتوسع واقتصادية. يحلل المشاركون أحمال الاستدلال ويطبقون استراتيجيات التجميع والتخزين المؤقت والتكميم والتوجيه ويصممون بنية خدمة ذاتية التوسع، مع بناء انضباط FinOps لتشغيل خدمات ذكاء اصطناعي وطنية ضمن الميزانية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Senior engineers and platform architects
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Analyze latency, throughput, and cost profiles of AI inference workloads
• Implement batching, caching, and streaming optimisations for model serving
• Apply quantisation, distillation, and model-routing to cut serving costs
• Design autoscaling GPU infrastructure for variable demand
• Evaluate build-versus-buy and model-tier trade-offs with TCO analysis
• Develop cost-monitoring dashboards and optimisation playbooks
Topics المواضيع:
1. Performance profiling of inference workloads
2. Serving optimisation: batching, caching, streaming
3. Model compression: quantisation and distillation
4. Model routing and cascade architectures
5. GPU infrastructure and autoscaling
6. AI FinOps: cost monitoring and TCO
7. Optimisation project on a live workload
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: vLLM, TensorRT/ONNX Runtime, Kubernetes autoscaling, cost dashboards
Stackability التكديس: Optimisation badge; part of the MLOps & Reliability specialisation.

Description (EN): An expert module that elevates engineers to solution architects. Participants translate business requirements into end-to-end AI architectures, select platforms and integration patterns, and produce architecture documentation and decision records. Case-based design reviews cover real government and enterprise AI scenarios.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء ترتقي بالمهندسين إلى مستوى معماري الحلول. يحوّل المشاركون متطلبات الأعمال إلى معماريات ذكاء اصطناعي متكاملة ويختارون المنصات وأنماط التكامل وينتجون وثائق المعمارية وسجلات القرارات، مع مراجعات تصميم قائمة على حالات حكومية ومؤسسية حقيقية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Senior engineers moving into architecture and technical leadership
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Translate business requirements into candidate AI solution architectures
• Design integration patterns connecting AI services to enterprise systems
• Evaluate platform, cloud, and sovereignty options against constraints
• Design for security, compliance, and data residency from the outset
• Develop architecture decision records and reference documentation
• Defend architectural choices in structured design reviews
Topics المواضيع:
1. AI solution architecture lifecycle
2. Reference architectures: RAG, agents, ML platforms
3. Enterprise integration and API strategy
4. Cloud, on-premise, and sovereignty considerations
5. Non-functional requirements: security, scale, compliance
6. Architecture documentation and ADRs
7. Design-review simulations on real scenarios
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Architecture canvases, C4 modelling, cloud reference architectures
Assessment التقييم: Architecture design package; peer design review
Stackability التكديس: Architecture badge; elective for Expert certificate; on-ramp to future AI Solution Architect track.

Module Name (EN): AI Engineering Capstone: Production GenAI System
اسم الوحدة (AR): مشروع التخرج: نظام ذكاء توليدي إنتاجي
Description (EN): The integrative capstone of the AI Engineer pathway. Teams scope, design, build, secure, and deploy a complete generative-AI system — combining RAG or agents, MLOps automation, observability, and guardrails — for a realistic enterprise brief. Work is assessed through a production demo, security review, and architecture defence before an expert panel.
الوصف (AR): المشروع التكاملي الختامي لمسار مهندس الذكاء الاصطناعي. تتولى الفرق تحديد نطاق نظام ذكاء توليدي متكامل وتصميمه وبنائه وتأمينه ونشره — يجمع بين RAG أو الوكلاء وأتمتة MLOps والمراقبة والحواجز الوقائية — وفق موجز مؤسسي واقعي، ويُقيَّم العمل عبر عرض إنتاجي ومراجعة أمنية ودفاع معماري أمام لجنة خبراء.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Candidates completing the AI Engineer Expert certificate
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design a complete production architecture for an enterprise GenAI use case
• Implement an integrated system combining retrieval, agents, and serving infrastructure
• Develop automated evaluation, monitoring, and guardrail layers
• Validate the system through security testing and load benchmarks
• Optimize cost and performance against defined service objectives
• Defend design decisions and results before a technical panel
Topics المواضيع:
1. Project scoping and requirements engineering
2. System design and architecture review
3. Sprint-based build with mentor checkpoints
4. Evaluation, security, and performance hardening
5. Deployment and operations readiness
6. Final demo, documentation, and panel defence
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Full track toolchain as selected by teams
Assessment التقييم: Deployed system; documentation package; panel defence
Stackability التكديس: Completes the AI Engineer Expert (Professional) Certificate.

Description (EN): A rigorous, applied grounding in the statistics that underpin trustworthy data science. Participants master probability, distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression, applying each concept computationally in Python. The module builds the inferential judgement needed to draw valid conclusions from data.
الوصف (AR): تأسيس تطبيقي دقيق في الإحصاء الذي يقوم عليه علم البيانات الموثوق. يتقن المشاركون الاحتمالات والتوزيعات والتقدير واختبار الفرضيات والانحدار مع تطبيق كل مفهوم حاسوبيًا في بايثون، بما يبني الحكم الاستدلالي اللازم لاستخلاص نتائج صحيحة من البيانات.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Analysts, graduates, and engineers entering data science
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Apply probability rules and distributions to model real-world uncertainty
• Analyze sampling variability using confidence intervals and standard errors
• Implement hypothesis tests and interpret p-values and effect sizes correctly
• Develop linear and logistic regression models and diagnose their assumptions
• Evaluate statistical claims for common fallacies and misuse
• Simulate statistical processes computationally to validate analytical results
Topics المواضيع:
1. Probability and common distributions
2. Descriptive statistics and sampling
3. Estimation and confidence intervals
4. Hypothesis testing and effect sizes
5. Correlation, causation, and confounding
6. Linear and logistic regression
7. Simulation and resampling methods
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Python, SciPy, statsmodels, Jupyter
Stackability التكديس: Core statistics badge; required for all Specialist Data Scientist modules.

Description (EN): A craft-focused module on turning analysis into influence. Participants apply perception science to design honest, compelling visualisations, build interactive dashboards, and structure data narratives for executive audiences. The module closes the last mile between analytical work and organisational decisions.
الوصف (AR): وحدة مهارية لتحويل التحليل إلى تأثير. يطبق المشاركون علم الإدراك لتصميم تصورات صادقة ومقنعة وبناء لوحات معلومات تفاعلية وهيكلة سرديات البيانات لجمهور تنفيذي، بما يغلق المسافة الأخيرة بين العمل التحليلي وقرارات المؤسسة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data scientists, analysts, BI professionals
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Apply visual-perception principles to select effective chart types
• Design clear, honest visualisations that avoid distortion and clutter
• Develop interactive dashboards for self-service exploration
• Construct data narratives structured around audience and decision
• Evaluate visualisations through critique and iterative refinement
• Present analytical findings persuasively to executive stakeholders
Topics المواضيع:
1. Perception science and visual encoding
2. Chart selection and design principles
3. Colour, annotation, and decluttering
4. Interactive dashboards and BI tools
5. Data storytelling structure and flow
6. Executive communication and presentation lab
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: Plotly, Power BI/Tableau, Matplotlib/Seaborn
Stackability التكديس: Communication badge; required for Data Scientist Practitioner certificate.

Description (EN): A specialist module that deepens modelling skill beyond the foundations. Participants master gradient-boosting frameworks, imbalanced and cost-sensitive learning, model interpretability with SHAP, and rigorous validation design. The emphasis is on winning reliable performance on messy, real-world tabular problems.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية تعمّق مهارة النمذجة إلى ما بعد الأساسيات. يتقن المشاركون أطر التعزيز المتدرج والتعلم مع البيانات غير المتوازنة والحساسة للتكلفة وتفسير النماذج باستخدام SHAP وتصميم تحقق صارم، مع تركيز على تحقيق أداء موثوق في مشكلات جدولية واقعية معقدة.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data scientists progressing to specialist modelling roles
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Develop high-performance models with XGBoost and LightGBM
• Design validation schemes that respect leakage, grouping, and time order
• Apply techniques for imbalanced, noisy, and cost-sensitive problems
• Analyze model behaviour using SHAP and permutation importance
• Optimize feature pipelines and model ensembles for tabular data
• Evaluate models for stability, calibration, and business impact
Topics المواضيع:
1. Gradient boosting deep dive
2. Validation design and leakage prevention
3. Imbalanced and cost-sensitive learning
4. Model interpretability: SHAP and beyond
5. Calibration and uncertainty estimates
6. Ensembling and stacking strategies
7. Applied modelling challenge
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: XGBoost, LightGBM, SHAP, scikit-learn, Optuna
Stackability التكديس: Advanced ML badge; core of the Data Scientist Specialist certificate.

Description (EN): A specialist module on modelling data that evolves over time. Participants decompose series, build statistical and ML-based forecasting models, and evaluate them with time-aware backtesting. Applications include demand planning, workforce projections, and economic indicators relevant to national programmes.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية في نمذجة البيانات المتغيرة عبر الزمن. يفكك المشاركون السلاسل ويبنون نماذج تنبؤ إحصائية وقائمة على تعلم الآلة ويقيّمونها باختبار رجعي مراعٍ للزمن، مع تطبيقات تشمل تخطيط الطلب وإسقاطات القوى العاملة والمؤشرات الاقتصادية ذات الصلة بالبرامج الوطنية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data scientists and analysts working with temporal data
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Analyze trend, seasonality, and autocorrelation structure in time series
• Develop classical forecasting models including ARIMA and exponential smoothing
• Implement ML and gradient-boosting approaches with engineered temporal features
• Design backtesting frameworks with proper time-based validation
• Evaluate forecasts using scale-appropriate accuracy and uncertainty metrics
• Compare model families to select the right approach per use case
Topics المواضيع:
1. Time-series structure and decomposition
2. Stationarity and autocorrelation
3. ARIMA and exponential smoothing
4. Feature-based ML forecasting
5. Probabilistic forecasts and intervals
6. Backtesting and forecast evaluation
7. Forecasting case study
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: statsmodels, Prophet, sktime, LightGBM
Stackability التكديس: Forecasting badge; part of Analytics & Experimentation specialisation.

Module Name (EN): Experimentation, A/B Testing and Causal Inference
Description (EN): A specialist module on answering "what actually works" with data. Participants design and analyse randomised experiments, compute power and sample sizes, and apply causal-inference methods — matching, difference-in-differences, and instrumental variables — when experiments are impossible. The module turns data scientists into trusted advisors on policy and product decisions.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية للإجابة عن سؤال "ما الذي يحدث الأثر فعلًا" بالبيانات. يصمم المشاركون التجارب العشوائية ويحللونها ويحسبون القوة وأحجام العينات ويطبقون أساليب الاستدلال السببي — المطابقة والفروق في الفروق والمتغيرات الأداتية — حين تتعذر التجارب، بما يجعل عالم البيانات مستشارًا موثوقًا لقرارات السياسات والمنتجات.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data scientists supporting product, policy, and programme decisions
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Design randomised experiments with valid randomisation units and guardrail metrics
• Compute statistical power, sample sizes, and minimum detectable effects
• Analyze experiment results with correct variance estimation and multiple-testing control
• Apply quasi-experimental methods including matching and difference-in-differences
• Evaluate causal claims from observational data using DAG-based reasoning
• Communicate experimental evidence and uncertainty to decision-makers
Topics المواضيع:
1. Causal thinking and potential outcomes
2. Experiment design and randomisation
3. Power analysis and sample sizing
4. Analysis pitfalls: peeking, multiple testing
5. Quasi-experiments: matching, DiD, IV
6. Causal graphs and confounding
7. Experimentation case study
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: statsmodels, DoWhy/EconML, experiment simulators
Stackability التكديس: Causal badge; core of Analytics & Experimentation specialisation.

Module Name (EN): Modern Data Engineering for AI Systems
اسم الوحدة (AR): هندسة البيانات الحديثة لأنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي
Description (EN): A comprehensive module on building modern, scalable, production-ready data architectures that feed AI and analytics. Participants trace the evolution from warehouses and lakes to the Lakehouse, master Delta Lake with ACID transactions and compute-storage separation, and work with ELT, streaming, data quality, and governance. A hands-on build of a local Mini-Lakehouse with Delta Lake and PySpark anchors the learning.
الوصف (AR): وحدة شاملة لبناء معماريات بيانات حديثة قابلة للتوسع وجاهزة للإنتاج تغذي الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحليلات. يتتبع المشاركون التطور من المستودعات والبحيرات إلى معمارية Lakehouse ويتقنون Delta Lake مع معاملات ACID وفصل الحوسبة عن التخزين ويعملون مع ELT والتدفقات اللحظية وجودة البيانات والحوكمة، ويرسّخ التعلمَ تطبيقٌ عملي لبناء Mini-Lakehouse محلي باستخدام Delta Lake وPySpark.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data engineers, data scientists, systems and AI architects, data-infrastructure leads
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Compare data warehouses, data lakes, and Lakehouse architectures across use cases
• Explain compute-storage separation and its impact on cost, elasticity, and scale
• Design ELT pipelines suited to modern cloud data environments
• Implement Delta Lake tables with ACID transactions and schema enforcement
• Develop streaming and event-driven ingestion patterns for real-time data
• Apply data-quality, observability, and governance controls across pipelines
• Build a working Mini-Lakehouse with Delta Lake and PySpark
• Connect Lakehouse components to AI, reporting, and analytics consumers
Topics المواضيع:
1. Evolution of data architecture: warehouse, lake, Lakehouse
2. Compute-storage separation and cloud economics
3. ETL versus ELT in modern stacks
4. Delta Lake and ACID transactions
5. Streaming data and event-driven architectures
6. Data quality, observability, and governance
7. Hands-on: building a Mini-Lakehouse
8. Serving data to AI and BI workloads
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: PySpark, Delta Lake, dbt, Kafka basics, Great Expectations
Stackability التكديس: Data-engineering badge; anchors the Data Engineering for AI specialisation. Derived from the existing Modern Data Engineering programme.

Description (EN): A specialist module on analysing datasets too large for a single machine. Participants master distributed computing concepts, write performant Spark transformations and SQL, and tune jobs through partitioning and caching. The module scales every prior analytics skill to enterprise data volumes.
الوصف (AR): وحدة تخصصية لتحليل مجموعات البيانات التي تتجاوز قدرة جهاز واحد. يتقن المشاركون مفاهيم الحوسبة الموزعة وكتابة تحويلات Spark وSQL عالية الأداء وضبط المهام عبر التقسيم والتخزين المؤقت، بما يوسّع كل مهارات التحليل السابقة إلى أحجام البيانات المؤسسية.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Data scientists and engineers working with large-scale data
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Explain distributed execution: partitions, shuffles, and lazy evaluation
• Develop analytical workloads with Spark DataFrames and Spark SQL
• Optimize job performance through partitioning, caching, and join strategies
• Implement scalable feature-engineering and ML pipelines with Spark MLlib
• Analyze query plans to diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks
• Design batch analytics workflows on Lakehouse storage
Topics المواضيع:
1. Distributed computing fundamentals
2. Spark DataFrames and Spark SQL
3. Shuffles, partitioning, and caching
4. Performance tuning and query plans
5. Spark MLlib pipelines at scale
6. Big-data analytics project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: PySpark, Spark SQL, MLlib, Delta Lake
Stackability التكديس: Big-data badge; part of the Data Engineering for AI specialisation.

Description (EN): An expert module that moves from predicting outcomes to prescribing actions. Participants formulate linear and integer optimisation models, run simulations under uncertainty, and combine ML predictions with optimisation to recommend optimal decisions. Applications span resource allocation, scheduling, and policy planning.
الوصف (AR): وحدة خبراء تنتقل من التنبؤ بالنتائج إلى وصف الإجراءات. يصوغ المشاركون نماذج التحسين الخطي والصحيح وينفذون المحاكاة في ظل عدم اليقين ويجمعون تنبؤات تعلم الآلة مع التحسين للتوصية بالقرارات المثلى، مع تطبيقات في تخصيص الموارد والجدولة وتخطيط السياسات.
Target Audience الفئة المستهدفة: Senior data scientists supporting operational and strategic decisions
Learning Outcomes (Bloom-aligned) مخرجات:
• Formulate business problems as linear and integer optimisation models
• Implement optimisation solutions using modern solver frameworks
• Design simulations to evaluate decisions under uncertainty
• Integrate ML predictions into prescriptive decision pipelines
• Analyze trade-offs with sensitivity and scenario analysis
• Evaluate decision-support systems for robustness and adoption
Topics المواضيع:
1. From predictive to prescriptive analytics
2. Linear and integer programming
3. Solver frameworks and model building
4. Monte Carlo simulation
5. Predict-then-optimise pipelines
6. Sensitivity and scenario analysis
7. Decision-science case project
Tools & Platforms الأدوات: PuLP/OR-Tools, SimPy, pandas
Stackability التكديس: Decision-science badge; Expert elective.

اسم الوحدة (AR): سير عمل علم البيانات المعزز بالذكاء التوليدي
Description (EN): An expert module on multiplying data-science productivity with generative AI. Participants use LLMs for code generation, automated EDA, synthetic data, and unstructured-text analysis, while building reproducible, verifiable workflows. The module defines the professional standard for responsible AI-assisted analysis.

• Evaluate AI-generated analytical artefacts for correctness and bias
• Implement agent-assisted automation for recurring analytics tasks
